drafted_from: tool row in tools/start-a-computer/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json, the provider description the request names, do-work/start-a-computer.mjs (priceOfAComputer) and tools/start-a-computer/test/start-a-computer.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "What would a cax11 machine from my provider cost me each month before I rent it?"
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads a request file and the provider description's price request, and rents nothing.
instructions: 1. Write request.json with machine {provider: "providers/rented.json", placement: {size: "cax11"}} (provider is the path of your provider description; location, image and the rest come from it).

2. Say the line in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:read-a-computer-price"} and runs node tools/start-a-computer/do-work/start-a-computer.mjs price request.json with the vault credential its description names (vault_key) handed on descriptor 3.
3. Read the JSON line: provider, placement and price {cents, currency}. A null price means the description reads none (a machine you already run with no price given).

worked_examples.title: The monthly price of a cax11 in the default location
worked_examples.ask: What does a cax11 cost per month?
worked_examples.given: From tools/start-a-computer/test/start-a-computer.test.mjs ('the price is the size\'s monthly price at the lease\'s location, in cents'): the provider answers GET /server_types?name=cax11 with prices fsn1 7.9900 and hel1 6.9900 (example.test, a made-up provider) (gross, EUR). request.json = {"machine":{"provider":"providers/rented-machine.json","placement":{"size":"cax11"}}}; hel1 is the description's default location. Run: node tools/start-a-computer/do-work/start-a-computer.mjs price request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: {"provider":"rented-machine","placement":{"size":"cax11","location":"hel1","image":"ubuntu-24.04"},"price":{"cents":699,"currency":"EUR"}}: 6.99 EUR at hel1. With "location":"ash" the price is refused ("no monthly price") because the description lists none there.
